product.title: Orasul cu nume de copac
product.description: Cassi a fost mereu mândră de originea ei portoricană, dar când alţii fac comentarii pe seama înfăţișării sale și îi spun că nu seamănă cu restul familiei, ea începe să pună sub semnul întrebării aproape orice. La școală, Cassi își găsește refugiu în olimpiada de matematică, de care e pasionată, și în prietenia ce se leagă între ea și Aaron, un coleg nou-venit care spune povești despre toate orașele cu nume de copac unde a locuit. Pe Cassi o liniștesc poveștile lui Aaron, făcând-o să uite că sora ei, Daniella, s-a schimbat atât de mult de când merge la liceu. Tocmai când lucrurile par să se îndrepte, o filmare video cu sora ei devine virală iar Cassi începe să se întrebe dacă Mapleton nu reprezintă doar încă un popas pe lista lui Aaron.   „O poveste emoţionantă despre familie, prietenie și maturizare.“ – KIRKUS REVIEW

# The Town with the Tree Name Book by Litera: A Story of Family and Self-Discovery

Discover *Orasul cu nume de copac* (The Town with the Tree Name), a poignant and engaging young adult novel from Litera. This book captivates readers with its exploration of identity, navigating family change, and finding strength in unexpected friendships. If you are looking for a story that feels both deeply personal and universally relatable, this coming-of-age novel is an essential read.

## A Journey of Identity and Friendship

The narrative centers on Cassi, a girl who has always been proud of her Puerto Rican heritage. However, when others comment on her appearanceâsuggesting she doesn't resemble the rest of her familyâCassi begins to question nearly everything about herself.

Finding solace in her passion for math olympiads and the captivating company of Aaron, a new classmate, Cassi is drawn into a mystery spanning multiple locales. Aaron tells stories of various towns, each bearing the name of a tree. These tales offer Cassi a sense of calm, allowing her to temporarily forget the drastic changes happening with her older sister, Daniella, as she enters high school.

As things seem to settle into a routine rhythm, everything shifts when a video recording involving her sister goes viral. Suddenly, Cassi must confront a deeper mystery: Is Mapleton truly just another charming stop on Aaron's curated list of towns? This thrilling plot twist forces Cassi to mature and look inward.

> *"An emotional story about family, friendship, and maturation."* â KIRKUS REVIEW

## Why Readers Love *Orasul cu nume de copac*

This book masterfully blends the elements of mystery with heartfelt drama. It speaks directly to the shared experience of growing upâthe confusion when your identity is scrutinized, the comfort found in connection, and the complexity of sibling relationships. The blend of cultural background (Puerto Rican heritage) with a sweeping tale of adventure makes *The Town with the Tree Name* an unforgettable reading experience for teens and adults alike.

**Key Themes You Will Explore:**
*   Finding your place amid changing family dynamics.
*   The power of friendship to guide you through uncertainty.
*   Exploring identity against external expectations.
